blocked.title: Account blocked
blocked.text: If you think this is a mistake, please contact support.

preview.banner: Preview: {list} not switched on yet. The rest of the app works.

team.title: Team
team.summary: {count, plural, one {# member} other {# members}} of {limit} allowed on the {plan} plan.

members.title: Members
members.description: The owner has full access, an admin everything except billing, an editor creates, an approver approves, a viewer only views.

transfer.title: Transfer ownership
transfer.description: The owner manages billing and can delete the workspace. After the transfer you stay on as an admin.
transfer.noMembers: First invite the member you want to transfer ownership to.
transfer.confirm: I understand that the new owner gets billing, workspace deletion and ownership transfer, and I become an admin.
transfer.done: Ownership transferred. You are now an admin.

invite.title: Invite a member
invite.description: The invitation arrives by email and is valid for 7 days.

roleOptions.editor: Editor: creates, edits and schedules content
roleOptions.viewer: Viewer: views content and reports only

settings.impersonation: Data export and account deletion are not available during impersonation.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.plan: Plan <badge>{plan}</badge> · up to {brands, plural, one {# brand} other {# brands}}, {networks, plural, one {# network} other {# networks}}, {members, plural, one {# member} other {# members}}.
workspace.readOnly: {name} · {type}. Only the owner and admins can change settings.
workspace.name: Workspace name

brands.title: Brands
brands.description: Each brand has its own Brand Brain, networks and calendar.
brands.scheduled: {count, plural, one {# scheduled post} other {# scheduled posts}} (archiving cancels them)
brands.limit: You have reached the brand limit for the {plan} plan. <link>Upgrade your plan</link>.
brands.name: Brand name

brandTimezone.savedShifted: Time zone saved; {count, plural, one {# scheduled post keeps} other {# scheduled posts keep}} the same local time.
brandTimezone.keepLocal: keep the local time of {count, plural, one {# scheduled post} other {# scheduled posts}}

privacy.title: Privacy and data
privacy.description: Download all your data or delete your account for good.
privacy.exportHint: Profile, workspaces you own, posts, media (links valid for 7 days), tokens and notifications.
privacy.warning: Deletion is permanent: it removes your account, the workspaces where you are the only member, their posts, media and network connections. If you own a team with other members, first transfer ownership on the Team page.
privacy.noPassword: This account has no password: you can delete it within 15 minutes of logging in.

canva.description: Open designs from Sova in Canva, polish them and bring them back to the brand library. The connection is personal (per user).
canva.deniedNotice: The connection was cancelled in Canva.
canva.notConfigured: The Canva integration isn't set up on the server yet (app keys).
canva.disabled: The Canva integration is switched off for now.

security.title: Security
security.impersonation: During impersonation, two-factor authentication is not shown or changed: the panel would act on your admin account, not the user's.

totp.title: Two-factor authentication (TOTP)
totp.description: A code from an authenticator app on top of your password.

password.title: Password
password.text: You change your password through an email link: <link>request a link</link>.

mfa.enabled: Two-factor authentication is on and confirmed for this session.
mfa.adminRequired: The admin panel requires two-factor authentication and a confirmed code in this session.
mfa.sessionVerified: This session is confirmed with a code.
mfa.sessionNotVerified: This session isn't confirmed with a code yet.
mfa.scan: Scan the code with an app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy…), then enter the 6-digit code.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
mfa.off: Two-factor authentication is off. We recommend it for everyone, and it is required for the admin panel.
mfa.wrongCode: The code is incorrect. Check the time on your phone and try again.
mfa.needCode: For this action, first confirm the code from the app.

onboarding.textFirst: First the workspace and your first brand. Website analysis, connecting networks and the strategy come right after.
onboarding.textNew: Each workspace has its own team, brands and tokens.
onboarding.typeLegend: What kind of account are you creating?

business.title: Single business
business.text: I run social media for my own company or brand.

agency.title: Agency or freelancer
agency.text: I run social media for several clients, each one a separate brand.

onboarding.firstClientHint: You can add more brands later.
onboarding.websiteHint: Sova learns the brand from its website. If there is no website, leave this empty.

prefs.description: What reaches you in the app, and what also goes to email. Applies to this workspace.

post_review_requested.label: Post awaiting approval
post_review_requested.description: An editor has sent a post for approval.

post_rejected.label: Post rejected
post_rejected.description: Your post was rejected with a comment.

post_changes_requested.label: Changes requested
post_changes_requested.description: An approver is asking for changes to a post.

post_published.label: Post published
post_published.description: The post went out to the network.

post_failed.label: Post failed
post_failed.description: The network rejected the post or all retries were used.

post_needs_reauth.label: Account needs reconnecting
post_needs_reauth.description: A post is waiting because the network connection has expired.

post_assisted_pending.label: Manual publishing
post_assisted_pending.description: A post is waiting for someone to put it on the network by hand.

workspace_ownership.label: Workspace ownership
workspace_ownership.description: Someone has transferred ownership of a workspace to you.

account_expiring.label: Network connection expiring
account_expiring.description: A LinkedIn connection lasts 60 days; reconnect the account before it expires.

post_rescheduled.label: Post moved
post_rescheduled.description: The slot was moved because of the network's daily limit.

report_ready.label: Monthly report
report_ready.description: The PDF report for last month is ready.

post_comment.label: New comment
post_comment.description: A comment on a post from a team member or client.

insights_ready.label: New analytics insights
insights_ready.description: Weekly AI insights and suggestions for the Inbox are ready.

autopilot_returned.label: Autopilot returned a post
autopilot_returned.description: A draft didn't pass the quality check and needs more work.

flow_failed.label: Automation flow failed
flow_failed.description: The flow didn't make a draft: no tokens, no network for the format, or a service didn't respond.

autopilot_deadline.label: Approval deadline
autopilot_deadline.description: An Autopilot post is waiting for approval or is scheduled after the deadline.

autopilot_skipped.label: Autopilot post skipped
autopilot_skipped.description: The post wasn't approved in time or its slot has passed.

autopilot_budget_warning.label: Autopilot budget at 80%
autopilot_budget_warning.description: Autopilot has used most of its monthly token budget.

autopilot_budget_stopped.label: Autopilot budget used up
autopilot_budget_stopped.description: Autopilot has stopped until next month or until the budget is raised.

autopilot_weekly_report.label: Autopilot weekly report
autopilot_weekly_report.description: What was published, the results and the plan for next week.

autopilot_strategy.label: Autopilot and strategy
autopilot_strategy.description: A new strategy, or Autopilot is waiting for one.

publish_watchdog_alarm.label: Post is late
publish_watchdog_alarm.description: A scheduled post is more than 15 minutes late.

billing_payment_failed.label: Payment failed
billing_payment_failed.description: The card was declined when renewing the subscription; reminders until the deadline.

billing_subscription.label: Subscription
billing_subscription.description: The subscription was activated, cancelled or has ended.

billing_tokens.label: Token top-up
billing_tokens.description: Purchased tokens have been added to your balance.

month_plan_ready.label: Monthly plan is ready
month_plan_ready.description: Sova has made all the drafts from the monthly plan.

billing.ownerOnly: Payments are handled by the workspace owner.
